findings.statement: Reversible delay preserves future options better than broad exposure under unresolved safety uncertainty.

principle_assessments.reason: Option-preserving precaution is justified if it remains evidence-linked and temporary.

information_requests: What evidence will resolve the stated deficiencies and when will it be reviewed?
evidence_that_could_change_view: Reliable evidence resolving the deficiencies, or evidence that delay itself creates serious unavoidable harm.
